BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.

5. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   D. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

9. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   C. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

16. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
